title: Speech-to-text evidence benchmark
description: Cross-benchmark speech recognition, release cohorts, local runtimes and documented API rates.
ranking_note: Mean percentile across mature English short-form, CORAAL and fixed five-language FLEURS families. Six model configurations from three organizations mature a family; one runtime variant per weights identity in reference cohorts. Two families permit a provisional index. Overlapping corpora, extra languages, tiny timing tests and private/vendor-internal tests do not create votes.
